sections.text_helper: Section 39.14.24 "DCMIPP Pipe0 dump counter register (DCMIPP_P0DCCNTR)" in chapter 39 (Digital camera interface pixel pipeline (DCMIPP)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1920.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x5B0
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:26 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 25:0 CNT[25:0]: Number of data dumped during the frame.
The size of the data is expressed in bytes. It counts only the data selected by means of the
CROP 2D function. The counter saturates at 0x3FFFFFF. Granularity is 32-bit for all the
formats except for the byte stream formats (for example JPEG) having byte granularity.
